turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes before a call, so let's not waste them. Who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and did anyone speak to him first?
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.
You've told me a number and a time, but not a date. Which day was that, and can you turn the screen so I can read the history myself? You also haven't answered who decided on the zero.
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.
"Maybe." That's not a decision, and it isn't about making me happy. If the zero comes off, I want it in writing today, and I still want to know who decided on it before anyone called me.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still want the zero withdrawn in writing, and I want to know who decided to enter it before anyone called me. I expect it in writing today.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, nothing agreed; you offered to remove the zero but hedged, and she wanted it in writing.
What moved her: nothing.
